name: Mail
description: Read and send email from Antimatter, over IMAP and SMTP.

settings_schema.header: Users connect their own mailbox over IMAP (reading) and SMTP (sending). Passwords are stored encrypted; users should use app passwords where their provider offers them.

settings.display_name: Allow mail servers on private networks
settings.help_text: When true, users can connect to mail servers on loopback, private and link-local addresses, such as a mail server on your internal network. Leave it off unless your mail server is on such a network: it would also let users reach the other internal services of the network this server runs in.
When true, users can connect to mail servers without TLS. Their passwords and mail then cross the network unencrypted.
How often the inbox of each online user is checked for new mail, to update their unread count.
Messages larger than this can't be opened in Antimatter.
